newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs plunge on land buying report.
newsitem.headline: JGBs plunge on land buying report.

text.p: Key March Japanese government bond (JGB) futures ended Thursday's Tokyo session sharply lower on a newspaper report that the Japanese government may buy collateralised land formerly owned by troubled financial firms to promote liquidity of land transactions.
The March contract ended down 0.80 at 125.60. Turnover was 67,547.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported that the government plans to use more public funds to buy collateralised land previously owned by failed "jusen" mortgage firms and other troubled financial firms.
